propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size cap but omits the shrink-only C901 cyclomatic-complexity ratchet, a sibling CI gate that fails when functions gain new or increased complexity debt

Developers adding flags or guard clauses to existing functions predictably hit the complexity ratchet (which lacks a behavioral test oracle) only at pre-flight lint, forcing unplanned extraction refactors
The complexity ratchet (.github/complexity-baseline.json, threshold 15) is part of make lint like the module-size gate but is undocumented in the Module-size policy section of AGENTS.md

AGENTS.md must document the complexity ratchet's command (ruff check --select C901), baseline file location, threshold source, shrink-only remedy (extraction, never baseline bumping), and how to census offenders
